g.title: MAXXECU_GPO_REV
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — BOOST_SOLENOID connector
GPO 1 (CMC B4) — Phase 1 approach only. Phase 3b uses PMU16 direct.

MaxxECU GPO sinks to GND when active (low-side switch). Does NOT supply +12V. MTune config: Outputs → GPO 1 → Function: "Transmission Reverse". Access: pin 2 of the Superseal 2-pin BOOST_SOLENOID breakout connector in the MaxxECU M50 terminated harness. Boost solenoid connector is unpopulated in M52 NA Phase 1. Leave connector unpopulated and splice from this wire. Phase 3b: this connector no longer exists (custom 07K harness). See harnesses/8hp-body-integrations-phase3.wv for the PMU16-direct-drive replacement.

g.title: W_GPO_REV
g.text: From BOOST_SOLENOID connector pin 2 (GPO 1) to relay pin 85. 18 AWG sufficient — carries only coil current (~150 mA). Engine-bay-only run.

g.title: REV_RELAY
g.text: Flyback diode required: 1N4007 across relay coil.

Prevents GPO output damage from coil back-EMF at relay de-energization. Mount relay in engine bay near the OEM Front Power Distribution Box or alongside the PMU16 (either physical location works). Engine-bay-side only. Coil draws ~150 mA — well within MaxxECU GPO output spec.

g.title: W_REV_OUTPUT
g.text: From relay pin 87 to X20 engine-side pin 10 (BL/GE). Replace the OEM connection at X20 pin 10 that previously received the mechanical gearbox reverse switch +12V. 16 AWG (matches OEM wire gauge). Engine-bay-only run — X20 pin 10 cabin side is unmodified OEM.

g.title: IGN_12V_BODY
g.text: OEM ignition relay — body harness switched +12V
Same OEM IGN relay rail used by fan relay and fuel pump relay coils. No additional relay or PMU16 output needed for the coil supply. Coil draws ~150 mA at 12V — negligible load on OEM ignition relay.

g.title: W_REV_COIL_PWR
g.text: OEM IGN relay +12V to relay pin 86. 18 AWG. Engine-bay-only run.

g.title: FUSED_12V
g.text: Relay contact supply (pin 30) — battery or main fuse block

Supply for relay contact pin 30 — independent of the coil supply. Source from main fuse block battery rail (PMU16 is not yet installed in Phase 1; Phase 3b uses PMU16 direct so no separate fuse needed there). 15A fuse is sufficient — reverse light bulbs draw ~4–8A total on E36.

g.title: W_REV_CONTACT_PWR
g.text: Fused +12V to relay pin 30 (contact input). 16 AWG. Engine-bay-only run.

g.title: X20_REV
g.text: BMW E36 X20 engine-side — pin 10 only

This is the correct pin for an E36 that started life as a MANUAL gearbox (ZF S5-31 / ZF S5-D). Manual cars have no EGS module — the reverse light circuit runs through X20 pin 10, not pin 22 (EGS path). X20 pin 22 (GN/WS) is the EGS automatic-gearbox path — leave floating. OEM wiring: X20 pin 10 → body harness → both reverse light bulbs (in tail lights). No body harness modification needed — relay output replaces the OEM mechanical switch. Source: harnesses/body-x20.wv pin 10; BMW E36 ETM section 0670 (jonkensy.com).
